label: Canakinumab (Ilaris) — gout · EMA II/0010 · 2-compartment SC · typical values only
_note: The regulatory model of the gout variation (pooled 1298 subjects; typical subject 93 kg, 34 y, albumin 43 g/L). Its covariate exponents were not published, so this is a typical-patient model with IIV and no covariates.

_source.document: EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation)
_source.subjects: Pooled 1298 subjects incl. gouty arthritis patients (the published analysis, Chakraborty et al. 2013, J Clin Pharmacol (doi:10.1002/jcph.162), abstract, used 601 subjects and reports CL 0.214 L/day, Vss 7.44 L, t1/2 25.8 d at 93 kg - a different run)

limitations: The covariate coefficients (weight exponent 'about 0.5~1', creatinine clearance) were not reported, so the model has no covariates. Only a 93 kg typical patient is computed.

Within the same report, the single-dose AUCinf (495) and the steady-state AUCτ (383.8) are inconsistent. For a linear drug the two should be equal; the model agrees with 383.8 (495 is left as a failure).
The residual error and the IL-1β binding parameters were not reported.
The model in Chakraborty 2013 (paywalled) is a different analysis (601 subjects), so its values differ slightly (CL 0.214 vs 0.229, Vss 7.44 vs 7.76).
The report does not say whether IV data were included in the model, so the IV route is disabled.

reportedChecks.source: EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) p.20 — 'volume of distribution at steady state was 7.76 L'. +-5% assumed; checks Vc + Vp.
EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) p.20 — 'half-life (t1/2) of canakinumab in adult gouty arthritis patients was 25.6 days'. +-20% assumed.

EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) proposed SmPC 5.2 (p.117) — single 150 mg SC dose in a typical 93 kg patient '(Cmax: 10.8 ug/ml and AUCinf: 495 ug*d/ml)'. +-20% assumed.

EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) same sentence, AUCinf 495 ug*d/mL. Computed as the AUC over 400 days after one dose (about 15 half-lives, i.e. to infinity). +-20% assumed. Note: for a linear drug the single-dose AUCinf equals the steady-state AUCtau, and the same report gives AUCtau,ss 383.8 at 150 mg. 495 and 383.8 cannot both hold for one typical patient; the model reproduces 383.8 (and F*Dose/CL = 0.595*150/0.229 = 390).

EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) p.20 — 150 mg SC every 12 weeks: 'estimated steady state Cmax and AUCtau were 11.3 ug/mL' and 383.8 ug*day/mL. +-20% assumed.
EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) p.20 — same sentence. +-20% assumed.
EMA assessment report EMEA/H/C/001109/II/0010 (Ilaris gouty arthritis variation) p.20 — 'expected accumulation ratio of canakinumab was 1.1-fold' at Q12W. +-20% assumed.
